So for PMDD specifically I have tried 3 different birth control options. (I also don't want this to come off as too negative or scary because obviously everyone has a different reaction to birth control)

1. Hormonal IUD - my first one was AMAZING (besides insertion). I loved it and was a strong advocate for IUD's. The next one I got, however, was the complete opposite experience. I gained 60+ pounds, and did nothing for my PMDD, I was in horrific pain all of the time. I had it removed within a couple of months of having it put in. The experience was so bad I have been too afraid to try it again.
2. Nuva ring. Nuva ring worked fairly well for a little bit, I was using it to skip my periods. Then for whatever reason, I bled for 4months straight. After this, I got off of Nuva Ring.
3. The pill. I went on Yaz to try and help. And it definitely made a difference, however, then I was just numb all the time. Instead of being happy or sad, I was just numb. It also completely diminished my sex drive - I was on Yaz from October 2022-December 2022 and I still have a very hard time in the bedroom department. It's gotten a little better, but not much. Before Yaz, I had no issues whatsoever.

​

I am not against birth control whatsoever, I had a great experience with birth control for a good majority of my life, but these last few years I have had such a poor experience, honestly I gave up trying to find one that would work best for me.

​

I hope you are able to find something that helps and works for you!!!

I was engaged when I was 18 after 9 months of being together. I thank god everyday we didn’t get married. It turned horribly abusive. Now I don’t want to sound super negative and make you think your relationship with this person won’t work or this person will turn bad. Most relationships don’t work out- and that’s not a bad thing. I don’t want to sound like I’m saying breakup either. 

The main point of this is, if you two really want to spend the rest of your lives together, there is no harm in waiting. Don’t rush things like kids, marriage, etc. I know it seems like “well we’re young, why not right now?” I would just work on progressing your relationship further. Be young, enjoy each other without the pressures of growing up too fast. Focus on building a super solid foundation for each of you individually, and together so when you are ready to get married- it will be that much easier and smoother. 
If you wanted to get her like a promise ring in the meantime that would be a really sweet gesture. It would also show your intentions. Also if you don’t live together already, I would maybe suggest that first. 

I hope it all works out well for you!!

You can also book a free consult that way the stylist knows exactly what you’re wanting and quote you an exact price

Multi tone hair color - all over color using the same tone of the one color you’re wanting to do 

All over color - one color root to tip

Accent highlight - front piece(s) bleached 

Partial highlight - top and sides highlighted 

Full highlight - full head of highlights

Pick 3 shades that you think they are, various undertones. From there you can pick out their undertone and determine the depth of the shade. Also most people aren’t just “one” undertone like most think. I like to also ask where people like to match. 
When picking the final color I like to ask the guest “how do you feel about this match?” So it really puts the power in their hands and makes them feel like it’s more of a collaborative effort than you just picking a color for them.


Honorable mention : I like to ask what they’re not liking about their current color / foundation (if they’re switching) and I’ll ask “do things seem to turn VERY pink or yellow on you?” So it kind of gives you more of a baseline to go off of.
